senses.gloss: (cmp. זָכָה a. סְכוּכִית I) [to be clear; cmp. סָבַר,] to look, see, foresee.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 14a:13">Meg. 14ᵃ</cite> (play on <cite ref="J00465"><he>יסכה</he></cite>, <cite ref="Genesis 11:29">Gen. XI, 29</cite>) <he>שסָכְתָה ברוה״ק</he> she looked into the future in holy inspiration.
<cite ref="Genesis 11:29">Ib.</cite> <he>שהכל סוֹכִין ביפיה</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>סכין</he>, incorr.) all looked at her beauty.
Lev. R. s. 1, beg. (ref. to סוכו = שׂוֹכוֹ, I Chr. IV, 18) the father of prophets שסוֹכִים ברוה״ק who see &c.—Part. pass. סָכוּי clear, transparent.
<cite ref="Niddah 24b:57">Nidd. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>עצמותיו סְכוּיִין</he> his bones are transparent (v., however, <cite ref="O00028"><he>סָבָא</he> III</cite>).
